verdict.rationale: Paxos documents rule-based orchestrations that trigger automatically when a bank transfer arrives, converting fiat to stablecoin and transferring it. Payments can also auto-convert stablecoin to fiat. These are fixed, product-specific automations (mint/redeem/convert) rather than a general rule engine; webhooks only notify external endpoints and are not counted here. Missing for 10: general-purpose user-defined rules across arbitrary event types, documentation of rule conditions and action configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: This powerful feature enables seamless fiat-to-crypto conversions through rule-based orchestrations that trigger upon receiving bank transfers.
Automatically convert the stablecoin to fiat, or opt to hold balances in stablecoin.
Convert USD to Stablecoins and transfer all in one call.
